summary: Implement a private atomic workspace config module, connect hook tenant/project resolution and operator root lookup, preserve legacy and environment fallbacks, then update tests and governed docs.
decision_refs: workspaces.json is the canonical local mapping and contains no credentials
organization sharing requires an explicit workspace or environment tenant
legacy project-names.json remains untouched and is migrated as compatibility input
server-side API and MCP grants remain authoritative
residual_risks: Existing users with an invalid workspaces.json will fail closed until they repair the file.
